why_ai: Flight parts are machined, processed and inspected by hand on qualified US shop floors under certified sign-off, and primes cannot switch approved sources quickly, though the paperwork around them is automating.
why_clarity: Drawings, AS9102 reports and customer acceptance criteria define exact, checkable deliverables, though thousands of part numbers vary and escapes surface late.
why_digital: Metal, drawings and certificates in, physical parts out from approved plants; ITAR and approved-source rules keep buying local and relationship-bound.

why_ai: Certified NDT inspectors physically examine life-limited rotating parts and sign dispositions where an escape is a safety event, so AI can only assist the call.
why_clarity: Acceptance criteria are written, but indication calls vary between inspectors and the truth about an accepted part may emerge years later.
why_digital: Physical castings, forgings and parts inspected in booths and on radiographs, shipped to engine OEMs.

why_ai: Capacity planning for rate breaks needs floor knowledge and a prime's trust, but the modelling itself is screen work that software increasingly does.
why_clarity: A plan either holds the rate or delinquencies show it within a quarter, but planners build it differently and feedback lags.
why_digital: Routings, machine data and forecasts in, capacity plans out on screen, though shop-floor validation and prime reviews are in person.

why_ai: Measurements happen at the part and a quality manager signs, but assembling AS9102 forms is document work AI is taking over.
why_clarity: AS9102 defines the forms exactly and customers accept or reject each report within days.
why_digital: Drawings, certs and measurement files in, a digital report out to a customer portal; the measuring itself is physical.

why_ai: Reading requirements off drawings and models is extraction that vision-language models already do on clean drawings.
why_clarity: Every requirement either has a balloon or not, checked against accepted reports, on thousands of near-identical tasks.
why_digital: Drawing and model files in, ballooned drawings and characteristic lists out, all on screen.

why_ai: Value checks against specs automate easily, but falsified certificates are adversarial and someone accountable must accept the material.
why_clarity: Spec limits make each value pass or fail, though forgery is only proven when someone investigates.
why_digital: PDF certificates and spec documents in, accept or hold decisions recorded digitally against physical lots.

why_ai: Status-chasing and date prediction automate well, but recovering a late lot still runs on relationships with processors and physical moves.
why_clarity: A predicted date holds or doesn't within days, on hundreds of lots a month, though each expediter works by feel.
why_digital: Lot data and processor emails in, dates and status out on screen, while the lots themselves travel between plants.

why_ai: Screening solicitations and drafting quotes is document work agents can do, though the owner's pricing call and past-performance record still matter.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules are explicit and awards are known within weeks on thousands of similar RFQs.
why_digital: Solicitations, technical data and award history in, quotes submitted online through DIBBS.

why_ai: Teardown, testing and FAA-accepted equivalence arguments need engineers and designees who carry approval responsibility.
why_clarity: The approval is a clear outcome, but each part needs its own argument and approval takes a year or more.
why_digital: Physical OEM samples and tests feed digital substantiation packages reviewed by the FAA.

why_ai: Feature extraction and hour estimation from drawings are learnable from job history, protected only by the estimator's feel for hidden cost drivers.
why_clarity: Quotes are numbers checked against job actuals weeks later, on hundreds of similar parts.
why_digital: Drawings and RFQ packages in, quotes out by email and portal.

why_ai: Matching PO clauses and spec revisions to procedures is rule-following that AI can perform, with a person resolving ambiguous clauses.
why_clarity: Each clause and revision either matches the router or doesn't, on every PO.
why_digital: POs, clause libraries and specs in, checked requirements out, all digital.

why_ai: Fleet tracking and forecasting are data work AI scales, protected by decades of curated history and analyst credibility.
why_clarity: Fleet records are checkable, but forecasts resolve over years and methods differ by analyst.
why_digital: Registries, operator data and research in, databases and forecasts delivered online.

why_ai: Primes require the standards and the scheme, which carry institutional authority no AI substitutes.
why_clarity: Standards development is consensus work revised every several years, with slow feedback.
why_digital: Committee drafts and audit records in, published standards and an online registry out.

why_ai: Clients pay for named advisers' judgement and site visits on high-stakes deals, though desk research automates.
why_clarity: Each engagement is bespoke and its conclusions are tested only as deals and programmes play out.
why_digital: Interviews, site visits and data in, reports delivered digitally to clients who buy through relationships.

why_ai: FAA designees make compliance findings personally and carry the accountability.
why_clarity: Approval is a clear outcome, but each package needs engineering argument and FAA review takes months.
why_digital: Client test data and samples in, substantiation reports out, with some lab and inspection work in person.

why_ai: Government officials must make and sign price determinations, though the analysis itself is screen work.
why_clarity: Price analysis follows written FAR methods on repeated buys, but whether a price was fair is argued long after.
why_digital: Cost data and price histories in, determinations and audit reports out, by cleared US government staff.

why_ai: Acquisition and pricing calls are high-stakes judgement made by a few executives.
why_clarity: Deal outcomes are known years later and each target is different.
why_digital: Financial and market data in, decisions out, sourced through banker relationships.

why_ai: Large rare aviation losses make underwriting judgement-heavy and relationship-bound.
why_clarity: Pricing follows methods, but whether it was right shows only when rare losses happen.
why_digital: Submissions and loss data in, policies out, placed through specialist brokers.

why_ai: Cutting trials run on real machines at test centres and customer sites, and customers trust named application engineers.
why_clarity: Tool life and cycle time are measured directly in trials, though each part needs its own strategy.
why_digital: Physical test cuts produce data and recommendations shared digitally with customers.

why_ai: Scorecards automate, but sourcing decisions and rate-readiness reviews still involve site visits and accountable managers.
why_clarity: Delivery and quality metrics are objective and recur monthly, though sourcing judgements vary.
why_digital: Supplier data in, scorecards and decisions out on screen, with periodic in-person reviews.

why_ai: Federal inspectors examine production sites in person and hold legal enforcement authority.
why_clarity: Regulations define what is checked, but the effect of oversight shows only in rare failures.
why_digital: Site inspections and records in, findings and enforcement out, by a single federal regulator.

why_ai: Hosting inspection records is commodity software that AI-native tools can replicate.
why_clarity: Records either conform to the form or not, instantly checked.
why_digital: Data in, hosted records and reports out, entirely online.

why_ai: Compiling industry statistics is desk research AI accelerates, kept by members' trust in the association.
why_clarity: Reports follow a format each year, but their influence is judged slowly.
why_digital: Member surveys and public data in, reports published online.

why_ai: Accredited auditors examine supplier sites in person and certificates are required by every prime.
why_clarity: Audits check systems against a codified standard and recur on fixed cycles.
why_digital: On-site audits produce certificates and reports uploaded online.
